title: finding(components,plugin-calendar): every Calendar mount opens on today's month, not the selected date's: CalendarView's header popover, ui:calendar and both date pickers pass neither defaultMonth nor month
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a), measured through a public UI door at one site and read at source at the other three. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` seat that claims it. ⛔ Not graded here.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`) from the objectui#10747 dev report (`out_of_scope_findings`, first entry; PR objectui#10798). This is a family **closure card**: one card for every position, because the same omission sits at four mounts.

## Measured (one site, public UI door)

`CalendarView` / `object-calendar` header date button. With `currentDate` on 4 March 2020 and the real clock on 2026-09-27, the header reads `March 2020`, but the popover under it opens on **September 2026**, with 0 selected day buttons in view. The author's selected date is two clicks per month away. Measured by the objectui#10747 dev with a throwaway probe at objectui base `c907a9c87` (run once, then deleted).

Mechanism, from the dev's reading: react-day-picker's initial month is `month`, else `defaultMonth`, else today. `selected` does not move it, and the popover's `Calendar` passes `selected` only.

## The family (read at source on objectui `origin/main` `6cf599985`)

`git grep` for a `Calendar` element under `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` (tests excluded) gives four mounts. None passes `defaultMonth` or `month`. Per file, `defaultMonth` or `month=` counts 0 in each of the four, and the same-element control `selected=` counts 1 in each, so the zero is a reading and not a dead probe.

| # | site | selected value it has | measured? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx`, header popover (about line 347) | `selectedDate` | **measured** (above) |
| 2 | `packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx` (`ui:calendar`, about line 55) | the node's selected date(s) | read at source; PR objectui#10302's body already recorded 「The calendar does not navigate to a selected date outside the current month: there is no `defaultMonth`」, as out of scope, not filed |
| 3 | `packages/components/src/renderers/form/date-picker.tsx` (about line 64) | the field value | read at source |
| 4 | `packages/components/src/custom/date-picker.tsx` (about line 56) | the field value | read at source |

⇒ In every one, a stored date outside the current month opens the picker on today's month. A form's date field holding last year's date opens a year away from it.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Each mount passes its selected date as the initial month (`defaultMonth`, the first selected date for a range or multiple), so the picker opens where the value is; with no value it still opens on today.
- One pin per site: a selected date in another year opens on that month; no value opens on today (control). The measured site's pin drives the real header button.
- `ui/calendar.tsx` is a No-Touch Shadcn primitive: the fix belongs at the four callers (or in one shared caller-side helper), ⛔ not in the primitive.
- Serial: site 1 is `CalendarView.tsx`, which PR objectui#10798 (objectui#10747) edits in the same popover element. ⇒ After that PR lands.

## Dedupe

Read by REST on 2026-09-27: the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (open and closed; the oldest updated 2026-09-20T16:33Z), matched against `defaultMonth|popover…(month|today)|(today|current)…month…popover|header date (button|popover)|opens on today`. 4 hits: PR objectui#10798 and objectui#10747 (the source of this finding), the seat 5 post objectui#10488 (a pointer to objectui#10747, not this defect), and closed PR objectui#10302 (site 2's sentence, noted and not filed). No card carries this defect. The lit control is `CalendarView`, with 18 hits in the same corpus.

Dedupe words: `Calendar opens on today month selected date` · `defaultMonth missing date picker` · `CalendarView popover wrong month` · `ui:calendar does not navigate to selected date`
